== Title ==
<span lang="ja">老いたな、かつての力はないぞ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-280o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：ベイダーとオビ＝ワンの両方が戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数を１枚加える。２：「ジェダイの帰還」「ジェダイ・ライトセーバー」「ジェダイの気配」か「ベン翁」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「戻ってくるべきではなかったな。」</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' You Have Grown Old. Your Former Power Is Gone.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are both participating in a battle. Add one battle destiny. 2. Cancel Return Of A Jedi, Jedi Lightsaber, [[Jedi Presence]], or Old Ben.

'''Lore:''' “You should not have come back.”

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
